steps.title: Attach probe
steps.instructions:
Put one M3x12 ultra-low profile screw through from the bottom of the probe and printed probe module. Screw this loosely into the bottom of the CNC carriage so that the point of the probe is towards the front.

Insert the other M3x12 ultra-low profile screw into the other side of the probe and printed module and tighten both screws.

Run the probe cable up the front of the carriage and through the hole in the top where it will come out later above the MGN12H carriage.

Loosely fasten with a cable tie around the fastening points in the centre-front of the CNC carriage.  Don't tighten this yet.

annotations.text: Install cable tie but leave loose

steps.title: Attach Klicky
steps.instructions:
Assemble the Klicky module with wires and magnet orientation as per instructions from the Klicky manual, substituting their carriage side part for the printed part from this project.

Put one M3x6 socket head cap screw through from the bottom of the printed probe module. Screw this loosely into the bottom of the CNC carriage so that the side with two magnets is towards the front.

Insert the other M3x6 socket head cap screw into the other side of the printed module and tighten both screws.

Run the probe cable up the front of the carriage and through the hole in the top where it will come out later above the MGN12H carriage.

Loosely fasten with a cable tie around the fastening points in the centre-front of the CNC carriage.  Don't tighten this yet.

annotations.text: Install cable tie but leave loose

steps.title: Attach PCB Klicky
steps.instructions:
Assemble the PCB Klicky module with heatset inserts, magnets and PCB as per instructions from the PCB Klicky manual, substituting their carriage side printed part for the printed part from this project.

Put one M3x6 socket head cap screw through from the bottom of the printed probe module. Screw this loosely into the bottom of the CNC carriage so that the side with two magnets is towards the left.

Insert the other M3x6 socket head cap screw into the other side of the printed module and tighten both screws.

Run the probe cable up the front of the carriage and through the hole in the top where it will come out later above the MGN12H carriage.

Loosely fasten with a cable tie around the fastening points in the centre-front of the CNC carriage.  Don't tighten this yet.

annotations.text: Printed and assembled PCB Klicky module
Install cable tie but leave loose

steps.title: Install X endstop switch
steps.instructions:
Install the X endstop D2F-L switch onto the carriage with 2x M2x10 socket head cap screws.

Run wires (not shown) around the front of the CNC carriage and up through the loose cable tie and through the top centre hole in the CNC carriage (with the probe cable).

steps.title: Universal belt clamp
steps.instructions: Clip the universal belt clamp onto your X-rail MGN12H carriage.

steps.title: Belts part 1
steps.instructions:
Before you install the CNC Xol-Carriage into your printer you need to prepare the belts. Your belts should be already installed into your gantry, following the Monolith Gantry instructions.

Insert the loose ends of the right side belts into the CNC carriage. Feed from the back through the belt slots

steps.title: Belts part 2
steps.instructions:
Line the CNC carriage up with your MNG12H and Universal Belt Clamp. Loosely install the four M3x8 button head screws.

Make sure to keep them loose at this stage, you still need to install the other end of the belts and add some pre-tension.

annotations.text: Leave screws loose. You still need to insert the other end of the belts.

steps.title: Belts part 3
steps.instructions:
Now that the carriage is loosely attached to the printer, push the loose ends of the belts between the CNC Xol-Carriage v2 and the Monolith Universal Belt Clamp.

Tighten the two left M3x8 button head screws just enough so that the belts can't be pulled out of the left side of the carriage assembly, but loose enough that you can still pull the slack out of the belts on the right side.

steps.title: Belts part 4
steps.instructions:
While holding the left side of the carriage to prevent the left side of the belts from pulling out, pull the loose ends of the right side of the belts so that slack is removed and the belts are even.

Tighten all four M3x8 button head screws to secure the carriage and belts in place.

annotations.text: Tip: Squeeze here to compress the left side of the belts while tensioning

steps.title: Belts part 5
steps.instructions:
Tuck the loose ends of both belts under the probe wires and tighten the cable tie that secures the wiring.
If you have too much excess belt, now is the time to trim it to your desired length.

steps.title: Belts part 1
steps.instructions: Before attaching the CNC Xol-Carriage v2 to the MGN12H carriage on your X rail, push all four belt ends through the slots in the CNC carriage.

steps.title: Belts part 2
steps.instructions: Loosely attach the CNC Xol-Carriage v2 to the MGN12H rail wit 4x M3x6 button head screws.

annotations.text: Don't tighten all the way yet.

steps.title: Belts part 3
steps.instructions: Pull the loose ends of the belts to take up slack and ensure they are even.

steps.title: Belts part 4
steps.instructions: Tighten all four M3x6 button head screws to secure everything in place.

steps.title: Belts part 5
steps.instructions:
If you have too much excess belt, now is the time to trim it your desired length.

Tuck the loose ends under the probe wires with one side over the other. Pull the cable tie tight and snip off the tail end.

steps.instructions:

steps.title: Toolhead board mounting screw
steps.instructions: Install the M3x12 socket head cap screw and large flat washer into the threaded hole in the top-rear of the CNC carriage. Leave them approximately 4mm out to enable installation of the toolhead board mount with your toolhead.

steps.title: All done
steps.instructions:
Hopefully yours looks something like this.

Time to install your toolhead. Enjoy!
